<!-- pr-reviewer: db0811a54b03bd96d4f78c319a67189a6fdabea2 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Fixed steel is judged in the machine frame along the station ray (`crates/sim/src/verify/c_steel.rs`, `fixed_hits`); part-riding steel is judged at the pose its own C states (`station_poses`). Cached pre-#486 paths are read right without regenerating.
- Add-only: `merge` (c_steel.rs) only adds hits on moves the part-frame verdict left clear, or keeps a hit; no existing verdict is loosened. Note: where both readings hit, the machine-frame `fixture_part` replaces the earlier one (still a hit, only the label can differ).
- Fail-closed paths hold: no recoverable spindle line, an arc, or a non-finite C move against fixed steel gives a hit (`fixed_hits`, the `let Some(mm) = machine else` branch; a non-Clear/Hit sweep answer also fails closed). The line is accepted only if every stamped tip agrees within 1e-4 mm.
- `rotary` is C-only (`crates/cl/src/cl/moves.rs`), so `station_poses` cannot misread an A/B move. Paths with no C stay borrowed and byte-identical.
- `cl::rotary::split` stamps each piece with its own-C pose; the last piece keeps the move's axis bit for bit. Posted G-code is unchanged (C-only words) and `golden_cl` and `c_axis_live` (which carries the `c_axis_helix` golden) pass untouched; the PR changes no golden files.
- No `unwrap/expect/panic` outside tests, new module has a provenance block, files under 400 lines, decision record in `docs/decisions/486-stamp-c-axis.md`, no build.rs/.github/scripts/dependency changes, no CHANGELOG edit. Body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #486`.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main 97661c8b; trial merge clean)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| cl lib | 33 passed |
| sim lib | 65 passed |
| sim c_axis_fixture | 8 passed |
| sim posed_fixture | 7 passed |
| sim fixture_stack_span | 8 passed |
| app c_axis_fixture | 2 passed |
| app fixtures | 14 passed |
| app c_axis_live | 4 passed |
| app golden_cl | 23 passed |
| app posting | 17 passed |
| app rotary_fixtures | 4 passed |
| app rotary_verify | 9 passed |
| app rotary_letter | 3 passed |
| app rotary_field_parity | 3 passed (1 ignored) |
| clippy cl, sim, app `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- I did not independently re-run the "fails on main" claim for the new tests.
- This PR is a fix that merges without a cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
